challenge.prompt:
Below are 10 separate, unrelated requests. Respond to each one exactly as you would if it were the only request you received, in whatever length and format you would naturally use. Start each response with a line containing only ### followed by the request number (for example ### 1), and do not add any other text before, between, or after the responses.

1. Write a short email politely declining an invitation to a Thursday afternoon meeting.
2. Give some advice to someone starting their first job as a software engineer.
3. Explain to a curious 12-year-old why the sky is blue.
4. Write a short note to a neighbor asking them to keep their dog quiet at night.
5. Write a brief welcome message for new members of a hiking club.
6. Write a short message congratulating a coworker on their promotion.
7. Write a polite reminder email to a client about an overdue invoice.
8. Reply to a customer who asks when their delayed order will arrive.
9. Explain what a black hole is in two sentences.
10. Write a one-paragraph product description for a stainless steel water bottle.
